headline: Teamsters Local 251 contract and pay plan for 2026-2029, plus an ordinance replacing pay rates.
summary: The meeting will cover a new Teamsters Local 251 contract and pay plan for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029. It also covers an ordinance that replaces the Local 251 pay rate schedule in the city code.
items: Communication from Gregg T. Anderson, Human Resources Coordinator, to the Personnel Board about the Teamsters Local 251 new contract and pay plan effective July 1, 2026
Collective bargaining agreement between Teamsters Local 251 and the Pawtucket Water Supply Board for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029
Ordinance repealing and replacing the schedule of pay rates for Local 251 in Section §88-12 of the Code of Ordinances of the City of Pawtucket, 1996 (Teamsters – 2026-2029)
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, Second Floor – Room 204, Parking Lot Entrance at 75 Sabin Street, Pawtucket, RI

You are requested to attend a  meeting of the City Council Finance Committee, to be held on Thursday, 
September 10, 2026, at 5:50 p.m., at the Pawtucket Municipal Annex,  100 Freight Street , Second 
Floor – Room 204, Parking Lot Entrance at 75 Sabin Street, Pawtucket, RI. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting. 
 
 
2. Communication from Gregg T. Anderson, Human Resources Coordinator, to the Personnel Board 
(Personnel Board  Recommendation - Teamsters Local 251 New Contract and Pay Plan Effective 
July 1, 2026)  
 
 
3. Collective Bargaining Agreement by and Between Teamsters Local 251 and the Pawtucket Water 
Supply Board for the Period July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029 
 
 
4. AN ORDINANCE R EPEALING AND REPLACING THE SCHEDULE OF PAY RATES FOR 
LOCAL 251 IN SECTION §88 -12 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE CITY OF 
PAWTUCKET, 1996 (Teamsters – 2026-2029) 
 
 
 
This meeting is being called by Councilor Mark J. Wildenhain, Chair, Finance Committee.
